excluded_on_inspection.UNESCO-Water-2025: E32768 recent/target region crosses a long bibliography. Excluded before scoring for this prose study, without moving the endpoint.

extraction: Unchanged pdf_prose_native_blocks_v2, native PDF block order. This is filtered report prose, not unmodified PDF text. Retains ordinary citations, prose bullet points and some footnotes. Short headings and many numeric tables are omitted by the existing extractor. No manual reordering, synthetic filling, target shifting, model-based selection or paragraph repair.
limitations: Convenience sample of public reports, not a representative natural-text benchmark. Three selected reports discuss economic/industrial themes, with some shared topical focus on minerals. New to this study does not mean unseen during pretraining. The same donor is reused, so intervals condition on that donor. This replication tests the existing fixed protocol on new reports, not an intervention on model capacity.
